candidates.title: Bijan Robinson receiving yards ladder
candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.0025 per receiving yard recorded by Bijan Robinson during the Cincinnati vs Atlanta Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 8, 2026. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
